description: Look up valid code values for filter fields by searching free-text descriptions. Use the type parameter to select the lookup table: naics (NAICS industry codes), psc (product/service codes), cfda (CFDA/Assistance Listing program numbers), awarding_agency (agency and sub-agency names, each with its tier and top-tier parent — the agency_name filters take the top-tier name), or recipient (recipient names with UEI/DUNS). Call this before filtering awards when you know a description but not the exact code. Returns matching codes and names for use in other tool filters.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–500), enforced client-side. The recipient lookup unions three upstream match buckets (name, UEI, DUNS) and can return up to 3x this value, so its results are capped to this limit before returning — the cap keeps them in bucket order, so name matches fill the page first and identifier matches appear only in whatever room is left. To resolve a specific UEI or DUNS, pass the identifier itself as search_text. naics/psc/cfda/awarding_agency honor this limit exactly.

search_text.description: Free-text search string — use a description, keyword, or partial code to find matches

type.description: Lookup table to search: naics (industry codes), psc (product/service codes, for the psc_codes filter), cfda (Assistance Listing program numbers, for the assistance_listings filter), awarding_agency (agency and sub-agency names), recipient (recipient names). Both filters are taken by usaspending_search_awards and by the filters object of usaspending_spending_by_category, usaspending_spending_by_geography, and usaspending_spending_over_time.

name: usaspending_autocomplete_filters

cap.description: The limit that was applied, when truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_match`: No codes or names matched the search text. `api_unavailable`: USAspending.gov API is unreachable or returns an error. `api_timeout`: USAspending.gov did not respond before the request deadline elapsed. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: How to reach the matches left out when truncated, or — when limit is 500 and all 500 slots filled — that the upstream maximum was reached and more matches may exist. Absent otherwise.

query.description: Search text sent to the autocomplete API

items.description: Matched entry — code/name for code lookups, name with tier and top-tier parent for agencies, name plus optional UEI/DUNS for recipients

abbreviation.description: awarding_agency only: the matched agency's own abbreviation, when it has one

code.description: Code value (NAICS code, PSC code, or Assistance Listing/CFDA number); use this in filter parameters — an Assistance Listing number goes in usaspending_search_awards assistance_listings. Agency rows carry toptier_code instead.

duns.description: DUNS number (legacy) — recipient type only; populated when the search text matches a DUNS

name.description: Human-readable name or description; for awarding_agency, the matched agency's own name, which for a sub-agency differs from toptier_name

tier.description: awarding_agency only: toptier for a department-level agency, subtier for a component under one

toptier_code.description: awarding_agency only: the 3-digit top-tier agency code, accepted by usaspending_get_agency

toptier_name.description: awarding_agency only: the top-tier agency name — the value the agency_name filters on usaspending_search_awards, usaspending_spending_by_category, usaspending_spending_by_geography, and usaspending_spending_over_time take. Those filters are top-tier only, so a sub-agency filters at its parent and the results cover the whole department.

uei.description: Unique Entity Identifier (SAM.gov) — recipient type only; populated when the search text matches a UEI

shown.description: Number of results returned, when truncated.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist beyond the limit and were left out. Absent when every match was returned.

title: Autocomplete Codes and Names
